items.stem: In limiting factor analysis with one scarce resource, products should be ranked by:

options.text: Contribution per unit of the limiting factor
options.rationale: Correct: ranking by contribution per unit of the scarce resource maximises total contribution.
This ignores the scarce resource usage.
Selling price alone ignores cost and resource usage.
Fixed cost absorption is not the ranking basis.

items.explanation: Correct: ranking by contribution per unit of the scarce resource maximises total contribution.

items.stem: A favourable sales price variance arises when:

options.text: The actual selling price exceeds the standard selling price
options.rationale: Correct: a higher actual price than standard gives a favourable price variance.
That is a volume variance, not a price variance.

options.text: The standard price is revised upwards
options.rationale: Revising the standard is not itself a variance.

items.explanation: Correct: a higher actual price than standard gives a favourable price variance.
